title: Which Channel, and What the Test Can Prove

scenes.tts: Stretch has to become electrical current somewhere. Which channel does that, and how would a deletion show it?
scenes.visual: Title card: Which Channel, and What the Test Can Prove. A membrane patch with a closed force-gated channel, and a question mark beside it.
scenes.narration: Stretch has to become electrical current somewhere. Which channel does that, and how would a deletion show it?

scenes.tts: This is the second question. Deleting a channel tests whether the reflex needs it. Showing that it converts force to current needs recordings.
scenes.visual: The three questions return; the middle one highlights. Under it, two separate tests: deletion tests requirement, current recordings test transduction.
scenes.narration: This is the second question. Deleting a channel tests whether the reflex needs it. Showing that it converts force to current needs recordings.

scenes.tts: Force can open a mechanosensitive channel. Inward current depolarizes the terminal, and if it reaches threshold the afferent fires.
scenes.visual: The membrane patch stretches; the channel opens and ions flow inward. A threshold line sits between the graded current trace and the spike train.
scenes.narration: Force can open a mechanosensitive channel. Inward current depolarizes the terminal, and if it reaches threshold the afferent fires.

scenes.tts: Deleting Piezo two in adult mouse sensory neurons impaired the lung inflation reflex.
scenes.visual: A lung with the inflation reflex trace, then the same trace blunted. Label: Piezo2 deleted in adult sensory neurons.
scenes.narration: Deleting Piezo2 in adult mouse sensory neurons impaired the lung inflation reflex.
scenes.caption: Deleting Piezo2 in adult mouse sensory neurons impaired the lung inflation reflex.

scenes.tts: And driving Piezo two positive vagal neurons with light caused apnoea. That uses Piezo two as a handle.
scenes.caption: And driving Piezo2-positive vagal neurons with light caused apnoea. That uses Piezo2 as a handle.
scenes.visual: A row appears: lung, Piezo2 required for the reflex, shown by deletion. Beside it, a light fibre over labelled neurons and a flat breathing trace, labelled population-activation sufficiency.
scenes.narration: And driving Piezo2-positive vagal neurons with light caused apnoea. That uses Piezo2 as a handle.

scenes.tts: The artery was harder. The baroreflex is the reflex by which a rise in blood pressure slows the heart.
scenes.visual: An artery wall stretching as pressure rises, with a heart below slowing. Label: baroreflex.
scenes.narration: The artery was harder. The baroreflex is the reflex by which a rise in blood pressure slows the heart.

scenes.tts: Channels were deleted from nodose and petrosal neurons. Blood pressure was raised with a drug in anaesthetized mice.
scenes.visual: A ganglion pair labelled nodose and petrosal; a syringe raises a pressure trace while a heart-rate trace falls.
scenes.narration: Channels were deleted from nodose and petrosal neurons. Blood pressure was raised with a drug in anaesthetized mice.

scenes.tts: Deleting Piezo one alone: no statistically detectable difference against littermate controls.
scenes.visual: Genotype table, row two: Piezo1 knockout. Text only, no numeral and no error bar: no statistically detectable difference in the reported assay.
scenes.narration: Deleting Piezo one alone: no statistically detectable difference against littermate controls.

scenes.tts: Deleting Piezo two alone: no statistically detectable difference either.
scenes.visual: Row three: Piezo2 knockout. Again text only: no statistically detectable difference in the reported assay.
scenes.narration: Deleting Piezo two alone: no statistically detectable difference either.

scenes.tts: Deleting both essentially abolished the drug-evoked baroreflex. The magnitude of its sensitivity fell from about five to under one beat per minute per millimetre of mercury.
scenes.visual: Row four: double knockout. On screen with signs retained: control minus 5.0 plus or minus 0.5, double knockout minus 0.6 plus or minus 0.4 bpm per mmHg, mean plus or minus SEM. Cited on screen: Zeng and colleagues, Science 2018.
scenes.narration: Deleting both essentially abolished the drug-evoked baroreflex. The magnitude of its sensitivity fell from about five to under one beat per minute per millimetre of mercury.

scenes.tts: And in conscious double knockouts, blood pressure in the active period was higher than in controls.
scenes.visual: A telemetry trace over a day, active period shaded, the double-knockout line sitting above the control line.
scenes.narration: And in conscious double knockouts, blood pressure in the active period was higher than in controls.

scenes.tts: The tempting reading is that every baroreceptor neuron carries both channels. Predict. Does that follow from these three rows?
scenes.visual: Two pictures side by side: one cell holding both channels, and two cell groups each holding one. Question: which do the data choose?
scenes.narration: The tempting reading is that every baroreceptor neuron carries both channels. Predict. Does that follow from these three rows?

scenes.tts: It does not follow. Either picture could fit, if the input that remains can hold the reflex up.
scenes.visual: Both pictures shown beside the same table: no detectable difference, no detectable difference, abolished. Caption: compatible with both, predicted by neither on its own.
scenes.narration: It does not follow. Either picture could fit, if the input that remains can hold the reflex up.

scenes.tts: One possible explanation is a nonlinear relation between sensory input and the reflex. This curve is a hypothesis, not a measurement.
scenes.visual: A saturating curve: hypothetical fraction of control sensory input on the horizontal axis, predicted magnitude of reflex sensitivity on the vertical. Marked: illustrative model, not measured. Second caption: neither deletion's effect on current was measured.
scenes.narration: One possible explanation is a nonlinear relation between sensory input and the reflex. This curve is a hypothesis, not a measurement.

scenes.tts: On this chosen curve, halving the input costs one point two three. An illustrative cutoff is one point four one. Neither number tells you what the real experiment could detect.
scenes.visual: The half-input point marked on the curve. On screen: 1.23 bpm per mmHg, the drop predicted by this toy curve; 1.41 bpm per mmHg, an approximate two-standard-error cutoff for hypothetical independent groups with SEM 0.5 each. Caption: neither establishes detectability in the published single-knockout experiments.
scenes.narration: On this chosen curve, halving the input costs one point two three. An illustrative cutoff is one point four one. Neither number tells you what the real experiment could detect.

scenes.tts: Losing all of it goes to zero on the curve, and the measured drop is easy to see.
scenes.visual: The curve traced down to an origin labelled hypothetical model. Beside it, kept separate, the measured bars: control minus 5.0 plus or minus 0.5 and double knockout minus 0.6 plus or minus 0.4.
scenes.narration: Losing all of it goes to zero on the curve, and the measured drop is easy to see.

scenes.tts: So the experiment shows a collective channel requirement. It does not measure summed current, or prove coexpression inside a cell.
scenes.visual: The two pictures again, bracketed and labelled: both still need further tests. No sum is claimed anywhere on screen.
scenes.narration: So the experiment shows a collective channel requirement. It does not measure summed current, or prove coexpression inside a cell.

scenes.tts: Separating them needs identified baroreceptors. Measure channel expression and mechanosensitive current cell by cell, under controlled mechanical stimulation.
scenes.visual: Two cards: identified baroreceptors with per-cell current recording and verified single-channel deletion; and controlled mechanical stimulation as the delivered force.
scenes.narration: Separating them needs identified baroreceptors. Measure channel expression and mechanosensitive current cell by cell, under controlled mechanical stimulation.

scenes.tts: The channels are required collectively in the targeted population. The result does not show that each neuron carries both.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: the reflex requirements listed for lung and artery, with the three questions beside them and the handle icon touching none of them.
scenes.narration: The channels are required collectively in the targeted population. The result does not show that each neuron carries both.
